paragraphs: Chapter 1099
Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (3)
The fight was growing larger.
Perhaps from the very beginning, the fight between the Vamel Alliance and the Demon Army was not just a localized battle over Solderet's arrangement.
A war with their fate on the line.
Especially for the Vamel Alliance, as Jin said, there was nowhere to retreat.
'That power I felt in the arrangement... if by some chance the enemies were to take that power, the war would be over that day.'
A great power of an unknown name.
The conditions to enter the arrangement to obtain that power were the body of Temar and Barisada.

'There is no guarantee that the Demon Army, who have conquered all dimensions, do not possess those two things. They probably possess them with a high probability. Even if we assume that the entry conditions for the arrangement are a peculiarity that has only appeared in our dimension, with their power, they would be able to analyze it by any means.'
Of course, if it was an arrangement that Solderet had prepared solely for Jin, they might not be able to obtain it even if they met the conditions, but it was not a matter he could be certain of.
For Jin, he had no choice but to consider the worst-case scenario.
Now that the military strength of the Demon Army was beginning to be revealed in earnest, Jin had to obtain that power to be able to turn the tables.
Before the third Plutonian Cannon exploded, the Genesis Knights took their positions closer to Laprarosa.
“Lord Focal, Lady Silkia. We must call for reinforcements.”
Jin informed Focal, Silkia, and the coalition members of the current situation as concisely as possible.
Since only four shots of the Plutonian Cannon remained, it was highly likely that they would have to endure a fierce battle for the entire five days.

[...For now, it is possible to open a dimensional gate that can send one ship to the mortal world. Silkia and I will go to the mortal world with that ship. A large-scale spatial jump that connects back to this place will require time, but we will finish it as quickly as possible.]
“We will be waiting.”
Literally only a minimum force would be left in the mortal world.
Jin decided to summon almost all the superhumans and main forces remaining in Kinzelo, the Garden of Swords, Tikan, and the Empire.
It was not a luxurious situation where they could fight with a rear guard.
[We will be back soon.]
Kwaaaaaa...!
The moment the single golden ship carrying Focal and Silkia passed through the newly formed small dimensional gate, Laprarosa fired the third Plutonian Cannon.
Fortunately, the firepower had not yet decreased. The Plutonian Cannon, this time as well, was forming a golden tsunami that swept over the entire enemy dimensional gate.
“We've already killed the seventh Genesis Knight...”
He didn't even bother to estimate how many superhuman-level warriors had been killed. About three thousand white ships had already been destroyed.
“I thought I'd never see a force like this after the Demon Realm bastards, but these crazy bastards... even the life of a fly would be more precious than this.”
“The problem is that those bastards are incomparably stronger than the Demon Realm, Sir Murakan.”
“That's right, Luna. Kelliac alone is a handful, but even his subordinates... there's no mess like this mess.”
When the golden tsunami began to subside, the enemies would send out a new fleet from beyond the dimensional gate as if nothing had happened.
That fact was slowly driving the coalition members insane.
“Still, those bastards' forces will not be infinite either. And as was revealed earlier, even without the Plutonian Cannon, we have the advantage in a fleet battle.”

“That is correct, Brother Van. Above all, the fact that they are only sending out their fleet is a comfort. If they had brought a completed Origin Stone to this place, there would be no reason for them to wage such a massive war of attrition.”
“It must be because of the interdimensional interference.”
The fourth, the fifth...
Even though the domain of Morganiel had already been dyed by the golden tsunami five times, the enemies showed no sign of falling.

The coalition members watched the dimensional gate with bloodshot eyes, their nerves on edge. Please, let it stop now, let the enemies stop appearing. That wish was shattered before even five minutes had passed.
“Agh, these disgusting bastards.”
This time too, a white fleet was emerging from beyond the dimensional gate. However, it wasn't that there were no changes at all.
'The fleet that had been consistently appearing with over a thousand ships has been reduced by half.'
Even at a glance, the arrow fodder had decreased.
Until now, whenever the Demon Army had sent out a fleet, they had always had at least three or more Genesis Knights on board, but now, the energy of only one could be felt.
“Are the enemies also starting to feel the burden?”
“Even if it is a disturbance to make us expend the Plutonian Cannon more efficiently, it is clear that they are feeling the burden.”
By the standards of the entire Demon Army, the damage they had sustained in this place was not that great.
It was on a level that was nothing but a drop in the bucket compared to Malugia's attack on all dimensions a while ago.
However, it was not as if they could immediately bring all the forces from each dimension to the domain of Morganiel.
Among the dimensions that had been damaged by Malugia's attack, many were in the middle of restoration work, and they did not have the leeway to undo the interdimensional interference.
“What shall we do, Brother Jin.”
Should they fire the Plutonian Cannon just the same, even if the enemy ships were reduced by half, or not.
If they fired, they could bluff that they still had plenty of shots of the Plutonian Cannon left. If they didn't fire, it would imply that their remaining ammunition was not much.
“Cease use of the Laprarosa main cannon. Until more than a thousand enemy ships appear like before, we will continue the battle with only auxiliary armaments. Golden Fleet, resume bombardment.”
Even if they bluffed, all they would gain was a little bit of time.

In any case, the time they would have to fight without the Plutonian Cannon during the remaining five days was scheduled to be much longer. Therefore, the Plutonian Cannon, of which only two shots remained, had to be used only when it could deal the maximum amount of damage.
“We must prepare for a ground battle. All superhumans on board the fleet will be dispatched. And, Brother Boras.”
{Yeah, Brother Jin.}
“If we delay the time we use the Plutonian Cannon as much as possible, can the hull's overload be recovered?”
{It depends on the time. If we delay it by a day, I alone can make it so we can fire about one more shot. But if reinforcements, Dr. Qwaul, arrive, the work can be done several times faster.}
“Understood.”
Now, the enemies' reaction was the key.
Because if the enemies, seeing them save the Plutonian Cannon, were to commit a thousand ships again, it would be impossible to buy time.
“It seems it is time for us to start moving as well.”
Sssreung...!
While the entire sky and land were ringing with the vibration of the flying ships' power sources amplifying, the sound of Barisada being drawn from its sheath stood out.
Originally, it should not have been audible, but all the enemies and allies were engulfed in the illusion that the small and desolate sound of friction had rung right by their ears.
It was because, for a moment, everyone was overwhelmed by Siron's energy.
Even those on board the ships, even the non-combat personnel who were focused on maintenance inside without coming out to the front lines.
He was different.
Just as he had confidently stated, not all Genesis Knights were the same.
The one who felt that fact most keenly was a Genesis Knight mage of the Demon Army, on board a white ship.
'That is... Chiron Runcandel?'
The Wind King of the 144th dimension, Andrei Zipple.
He had personally witnessed Chiron's death in his own dimension in the past.
And he had been dispatched to other dimensions several times, and in those places too, he had faced a Siron who had reached the state of a Genesis Knight, or had witnessed his end.
However, the Chiron who had drawn his sword now was different.
He was not soaked in demonic transformation, nor was he in a state where his body had been weakened from fighting alone for a long time.
He was not even emitting a temporarily stronger energy due to the rampage of demonic transformation.
'And next to him, ah... is that man the Battle God of the Plutonians, Van?'
In any dimension except this one, Van had never been liberated in a complete state.
That was why his power was only passed down like a legend among the Demon Army.
The feats that Van had shown in this dimension so far had not yet been widely reported to the Demon Army.
'And Jin Runcandel, Luna Runcandel, and even Murakan. As expected, the bombardment was not the only problem. Even if we withstand that and advance, in the end, we must defeat them...'
A great gap existed.
As befitting a person who had crossed all sorts of lines of death and finally reached the state of a Genesis Knight, Andrei immediately recognized and acknowledged the gap between them and himself.

'It doesn't matter. The enemy's bombardment is surely limited, and our fleet and Genesis Knights will continue to be committed. I will avoid close combat and buy time. In any case, the enemy Genesis Knights will not be able to recklessly close the distance either. Since a bombardment battle will now begin.'
The bombardment battle between the Golden Fleet and the White Fleet.
Andrei predicted that the coalition's Genesis Knights would not be able to carelessly step forward in its shockwave.
Unlike them, who had numerous Genesis Knights on standby behind the dimensional gate, the Vamel Alliance only had five.
As if by agreement, the two fleets began to bombard each other at the same time.
The sky and the land were instantly distorted by lightning and magic, and every time the main cannons clashed, a powerful shockwave spread, enough to shake the fleets.

'It is too high a risk for the coalition to deploy all five of their Genesis Knights to the front lines from the start. And those people should be capable of fleet-level or higher ultra-long-range attacks with just their own strength. In the first place, a close-quarters battle will not even be...'
The moment he thought that far, Andrei flinched and looked beyond the bridge.
“Lord Andrei?”
The adjutants did not understand Andrei's sudden reaction and just looked beyond the bridge in the same way.
All that was visible was just a great explosion where the sun energy spewed out by Laprarosa's auxiliary armaments, the Golden Fleet's lightning, and the White Fleet's magic were mixed.
However, in that chaotic scenery, Andrei was feeling the energies of the enemy Genesis Knights getting closer.
And at a very fast speed. To the point where he could believe it even if they were running on flat ground, not in the midst of a terrifying bombardment.
“Evade to the rear at once! Prepare for im—!”
Swaaaaak-!
Suddenly, a single line of sword-aura tore through the bridge of the flagship Andrei was on and left a sharp trajectory.
That trajectory did not disappear even after completely bisecting the flagship diagonally and remained in its place, emitting light.
It was Chiron's single sword strike.
“Andrei Zipple, it seems you have gained some enlightenment in that world of yours. But in the end, you have met me here, so for you, this is a dead end.”
